title: CubeSat (CDS Rev 14.1)
description: A parametric CubeSat built to the CubeSat Design Specification Rev 14.1 (Cal Poly SLO, 2022, Appendix B) and the PC/104 Specification v2.4: rails, frames, separation springs and RBF pin, a PC/104 stack, solar cells and two hinged wings, a turnstile antenna module tuned to its frequency, a battery and an attitude-control module, and an optional camera (2U and larger). Pick 1U to 6U, fold the wings and antennas out, grow the stack as far as it fits: twelve assertions check the standard (mass, rail envelope, protrusions, clearances). Origin at the geometric centre, Z along the rails.
author: 3DCraft Jigs
